# Nexfound

> Nexfound builds focused, payment-ready web and mobile MVPs in 30 days starting from ₹50,000.

## Overview
Nexfound (https://nexfound.in) is an elite product development studio founded by Danish (@iam_danishm). We help non-technical founders, early-stage startups, and small businesses turn raw concepts and notes into live, validated, revenue-ready MVPs.

## Key Principles
- **One Platform First**: We prioritize whether a Web-First (Next.js) or Mobile-First (Flutter / React Native) approach validates customer demand quickest, avoiding costly multi-platform premature optimization.
- **Ruthless Scope Discipline**: We eliminate non-essential bloat, focusing strictly on the core transaction flow that converts users and captures revenue.
- **100% Code Ownership**: Clients receive complete repository ownership, infrastructure access, environment secrets, and clean documentation upon delivery. Zero platform lock-in.
- **Fixed Timeline & Predictable Pricing**: Strict 30-day turnaround, starting from ₹50,000 INR ($600 USD) with no hidden agency retainer traps.

## Core Services
- **30-Day MVP Sprint**: Full-stack MVP development, responsive UI, database schema, user authentication, direct payments integration, transactional emails, analytics, and admin dashboard.
- **Custom Web & Mobile Development**: High-performance Next.js web applications, Flutter cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android.
- **Codebase Rescue**: Rapid technical audit, refactoring, security hardening, and stabilization for stalled, buggy, or abandoned contractor projects.
- **Founder Technical Partnership**: Post-launch feature iteration, architecture advisory, and technical scaling support.

## Case Studies
- **DalalFree**: Zero-brokerage commercial real estate marketplace with map search, OTP authentication, and automated landlord lead routing. Launched in 24 days.
- **EV Dock**: Real-time EV charging station discovery and slot reservation platform with interactive mapping, station availability, and instant UPI checkout. Launched in 28 days.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Mobile**: Flutter, React Native
- **Backend & Database**: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, Redis
- **Payments & Billing**: Razorpay, Stripe, Cashfree, UPI
- **Deployment & Cloud**: Vercel, AWS, Cloudflare
